title: C: HTTP Server (Simulated)
description: Simulate an HTTP server that parses HTTP request strings and generates HTTP responses.

steps.title: Parse HTTP Request
steps.description: Write a function that parses an HTTP GET request string like 'GET /index.html HTTP/1.1' and extracts the method, path, and version. Print each part.
hints: Use `sscanf` to parse: `sscanf(req, "%s %s %s", method, path, version)`.
Print method, path, and version separately.

verification.failureMessage: Parse and print method, path, and version

steps.title: Generate HTTP Response
steps.description:
Write a function that generates a simple HTTP response: `HTTP/1.1 200 OK Content-Type: text/html

Hello

` for success, or `404 Not Found` for unknown routes. Test with '/' and '/unknown'.
hints: Use `sprintf` to build the response string.
Simple routing: '/' returns 200, anything else returns 404.
Print the full response including status line.
